lines.text: Your twenty-dollar Claude plan can't do hundred-dollar work.
lines.role: hook: the claim as action ($20 under $100)

lines.text: A free tool says it can. I checked.
lines.role: the free tool steps in; 'I checked': the barbell drops

lines.text: Every new chat starts from zero, so Claude Code reads your files again.
The fix is Graphify, with about a hundred fifty thousand stars on GitHub.
It maps your code once, so Claude looks things up instead of rereading.
The big claim is seventy times less token use, but only in its best case.
Real tests? One saves some. One uses more.
And the hundred-dollar plan is five times the usage. Nothing we found comes close.
The setup's in the link in bio.
lines.role: end scene: saveable card + link in bio

lines.text: Want the next one? Follow, and you'll see it.
